name: XX_merc engineer drones holder
comment: What the Space Merc Engineer's drones castable spawns (SpawnMonster P9TE) where the player stands: the invisible centre the drones circle. The template (TDB 51000 #1464) matches the hash by name; the client has no template data, so the invisible look as other anchors (npc/main-pierrot2), level and health as the engineer's, and a lifetime a little longer than the drones' 10 s are guesses.
